q: In the dually flat geometry of an exponential family, the e-geodesics and m-geodesics are related to which pair of divergences?
opts: KL divergence D(P||Q) and its reverse D(Q||P)
exp: In the Amari dual geometry: e-geodesics are projections with respect to D(·||Q) (KL), m-geodesics with respect to D(P||·). The Pythagorean theorem holds for orthogonal e/m projections.
